exceptions.rationale: Transitive Prisma 7.10.0 configuration dependency; npm offers only an incompatible Prisma 6 downgrade and no validated Prisma 7 remediation is currently available.
exceptions.remediation: Review each compatible Prisma release, upgrade Prisma and its client together when the dependency is fixed, then remove this exception after the full backend validation passes.

exceptions.rationale: Transitive Prisma CLI dependency in a PostgreSQL-only project; the affected MySQL authentication path is not used, but the package remains visible and tracked until Prisma supplies a compatible update.
exceptions.remediation: Review each compatible Prisma release, verify the tooling image and PostgreSQL workflows, upgrade when Prisma removes the affected mysql2 version, and delete this exception.

exceptions.rationale: Transitive Prisma CLI dependency in a PostgreSQL-only project; MySQL compressed-protocol handling is not exercised, but the advisory remains explicitly visible.
exceptions.remediation: Track compatible Prisma releases, upgrade Prisma and its client together after validation, and remove the exception once mysql2 is no longer affected.
